title: Machine Learning Basics
content: Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that learns patterns from data for prediction and decision making.

title: Deep Learning

title: General Technology and Computer Science Overview
content: Computer science is the study of computers, software, algorithms, data, networks, and information systems. Technology is used in education, healthcare, banking, business, communication, transportation, agriculture, entertainment, and scientific research. A computer system consists of hardware and software. Hardware includes processors, memory, storage devices, keyboards, displays, sensors, and network devices. Software includes operating systems, applications, programming languages, databases, and development tools. Programming involves writing instructions that allow computers to solve problems and perform tasks. Common programming languages include Python, Java, C, C++, JavaScript, and SQL. Data is information that can be stored, processed, analyzed, and transmitted. Databases are used to organize and retrieve structured information. Common database concepts include tables, records, fields, queries, indexing, transactions, and data management. Networks allow computers and devices to communicate and share information. The internet connects computers around the world and provides services such as websites, email, cloud computing, file sharing, and online communication. Artificial intelligence, or AI, is a field of computer science concerned with creating systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. Machine learning is a branch of artificial intelligence in which algorithms learn patterns from data and use those patterns to make predictions or decisions. Deep learning is a type of machine learning that uses neural networks with multiple layers. Natural language processing, or NLP, deals with the processing and analysis of human language by computers. NLP applications include text classification, sentiment analysis, machine translation, question answering, speech processing, information extraction, chatbots, search engines, summarization, and language generation. Information retrieval is the process of finding relevant information or documents from a collection based on a user's query. Search engines use lexical matching, ranking algorithms, semantic similarity, indexing, and retrieval models to find useful results. Algorithms are step-by-step procedures for solving computational problems. Common algorithmic concepts include searching, sorting, optimization, classification, prediction, and ranking. Data structures such as arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hash tables, and matrices help organize data efficiently. Statistics and probability are important for data analysis and machine learning. Concepts include mean, median, probability, distribution, correlation, variance, and sampling. Cybersecurity protects computers, networks, applications, and information from unauthorized access and attacks. Security concepts include authentication, authorization, encryption, privacy, passwords, firewalls, and secure communication. Cloud computing provides computing resources such as servers, storage, databases, networking, and software over the internet. Web applications commonly use frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and backend technologies such as Python, Java, Node.js, databases, and REST APIs. APIs allow different software applications to communicate with each other. Software development commonly involves requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, debugging, version control, deployment, and maintenance. Git is a version control system used to track changes in source code, while GitHub is a platform used to host and collaborate on Git repositories. Testing helps verify that software behaves correctly and includes unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and performance testing. Docker is a containerization technology that packages applications and their dependencies so they can run consistently across environments. Data science combines programming, statistics, machine learning, visualization, and domain knowledge to extract useful insights from data. Modern intelligent systems often combine databases, algorithms, machine learning models, natural language processing, information retrieval, APIs, web applications, and cloud or container technologies to solve real-world problems.

title: Everyday Life and Society
content: Human life is influenced by family, education, work, culture, society, environment, health, transportation, food, communication, and daily activities. Families provide support, care, guidance, and social relationships. Education helps people develop knowledge, skills, creativity, discipline, and problem-solving abilities. Schools, colleges, universities, libraries, teachers, books, examinations, and practical activities are important parts of education. Employment and business provide opportunities for people to earn income and develop professional skills. Different occupations include teaching, farming, engineering, medicine, construction, banking, administration, trade, manufacturing, design, journalism, tourism, and public service. Agriculture provides food and raw materials and depends on soil, water, climate, crops, livestock, irrigation, farmers, markets, and transportation. Food includes grains, rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits, milk, pulses, spices, and other products. Health depends on nutrition, exercise, sleep, hygiene, clean water, sanitation, medical care, hospitals, doctors, nurses, medicines, and preventive practices. Transportation allows people and goods to move from one location to another using roads, buses, cars, bicycles, trains, ships, and airplanes. Communication allows people to exchange information through conversation, letters, newspapers, television, radio, telephones, mobile devices, email, and social media. Cities contain houses, apartments, offices, schools, hospitals, shops, markets, roads, parks, public buildings, and transportation systems. Villages commonly depend on agriculture, local businesses, natural resources, community activities, and traditional occupations. The environment includes air, water, soil, forests, rivers, oceans, mountains, animals, plants, and microorganisms. Environmental problems include pollution, deforestation, waste, climate change, water scarcity, soil degradation, and loss of biodiversity. Recycling, conservation, renewable energy, planting trees, reducing waste, and protecting natural resources can support environmental sustainability. Weather describes atmospheric conditions such as temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind, clouds, and storms. Climate describes long-term patterns of weather in a region. Culture includes language, traditions, festivals, art, music, literature, clothing, food, customs, beliefs, and social practices. Sports and physical activities such as cricket, football, badminton, running, swimming, cycling, and athletics support fitness and recreation. Travel and tourism involve visiting different places for education, business, recreation, culture, nature, and historical experiences. Money and finance are part of everyday life and include income, expenses, savings, banking, loans, payments, prices, markets, trade, and investment. Governments provide public services such as education, healthcare, transportation, infrastructure, law enforcement, sanitation, and administration. Communities depend on cooperation, responsibility, communication, respect, and participation. Technology is increasingly used in education, communication, banking, shopping, transportation, entertainment, healthcare, and public services. Daily routines may include waking up, preparing food, travelling, studying, working, exercising, communicating with others, shopping, relaxing, and sleeping. Good time management, healthy habits, responsible use of resources, respectful communication, and continuous learning can improve everyday life.
